title: Backup
paragraphs: “Deep in the mountains of this country… there are some a little further south, too, so that should work out just fine.”
“So the problem is that these dragons live near human settlements, is it?”
“They’re weak, so they were driven out of the deep mountains and now live in places like that.”
“Take that verbal attack from me!” I said, with a mocking tone. Well, go ahead and be jealous.
“Growl, growl.”
Wh—? Rival nodded without a second thought. Does that mean he’s not jealous? What a heartless guy. I can’t believe it.
“He doesn’t even flinch when his parents are insulted, does he?”
“How should I put it… his reaction seems more mature than the Spear Hero’s, doesn’t it?”

“Hmm… Personally, I don’t really feel like slaying dragons right now. I know this sounds rude, but I was just talking to a talking dragon a moment ago, so slaying dragons just to raise another one… well.”
“So what are you going to do, then?”
“Do they sell that kind of stuff in Melromarc? Materials like that?”
“I think they do, but I’ve heard there are a lot of fakes.”
Éclair explains. That’s certainly a story I’ve heard before.
“Gau, Gaaah!”
While we were talking about that, Rival lightly bit his own hand, letting blood drip, and began drawing some sort of pattern on his forehead and chest. What on earth is he doing?
“I wonder what he’s up to?”
“Could this be… a monster emblem? It looks familiar. Though it’s kind of strange for a monster to draw it itself, isn’t it?”
“Gau!”
Then Rival pointed at Father and barked.
“Boo… I don’t want to!”
Sakura-chan seized the moment to protest. I wonder what she’s trying to say?
“Hmm… Considering this reaction and what Motoyasu-kun did with the Filolial egg, I guess she’s designating me as her owner?”
“Gau!”
Rival nodded vigorously, even though he can’t actually speak. You bastard… Using body language to communicate even though you can’t speak? That’s just too underhanded.
“Naofumi, are you going to be the dragon’s owner?”
“I guess so. It seems like that’s what she wants.”
“Boo…”

Sakura-chan is puffing out her cheeks. Come to think of it, in this world, I’m the one registered as Sakura-chan’s master, aren’t I!? Which also means I’m Filo-tan’s master, too. Ugh… My head is suddenly getting really hot. Bah!
“W-wait, Motoyasu-kun just suddenly started spurting a waterfall of blood from his nose!?”
“Gau!?”
Rival backed away.
“Did Lord Kitamura try to use his own blood to steal the master-servant contract with a sneak attack?”
“Given how Motoyasu-kun is right now, he might just do that… he’s always trying to get in the way.”
“N-no, that’s not it. Come to think of it, Sakura-chan… she realized that I’m actually Filo-tan’s master!”
The master of Filo-tan, a dream come true! I am now! Her master!
“Boo… Sakura, I want Naofumi to be my master too.”
“I suppose multiple contracts are possible, aren’t they?”
“Gau! Gau gau!”
Rival is seizing this opportunity to jump on Father and assert himself. This reaction… I’ve analyzed and understood Rival’s behavior patterns from past loops.
“He’s aiming for Father’s first time! I won’t let that happen!”
“What a lewd way to put it… Lord Kitamura, shouldn’t you stop your nosebleed first?”
“Hahaha! For me, as Filo-tan’s master, something like that is a piece of cake!”
“No, your nose is bleeding pretty dangerously, isn’t it?”
Oof… My love for Filo-chan is making me dizzy. But it can’t be helped. It’s the result of my feelings swelling up so much that they’ve manifested as blood. In other words, this blood is my love.
“For now, cast a healing spell on Motoyasu-kun…”
Father cast “Zweite Heal” on me, but the nosebleed started right away. Ah, my unstoppable love is overflowing.
“It’s starting again the moment you’re healed!? Motoyasu-kun! Pull yourself together!”
“Motoyasu-sama! Please pull yourself together!　You mustn’t leave Yuki and the others behind!”
“Hmm?”
I think I snapped back to my senses at the sound of Yuki-chan and Sakura-chan’s voices. …My head feels kind of clear all of a sudden.
“I feel like my excitement is starting to subside.”
“Isn’t it just that you’ve lost blood, so your blood pressure’s physically dropped?”
“As for the Spear Hero… well, just from today alone, I’ve come to understand that he’s… a rather unique individual.”

Zou is muttering to himself, seemingly convinced he’s figured me out. Meanwhile, Kou is trying to climb onto Zou’s back from behind. As expected, Kou is a bit clueless when it comes to reading the room. But that’s part of what makes him so cute!
“Well, Motoyasu-kun seems fine for now, so let’s go ahead and register this kid just as she wants. As for Sakura-chan, we’ll talk it over with Motoyasu-kun later and decide then.”
“Boo…”
Sakura-chan is quietly protesting, clearly dissatisfied, but Father is prioritizing Rival.
“You’ve got to stand up for yourself more, Sakura-chan!”
“Boo…!”
In response to my suggestion, Sakura-chan raised her voice even louder than before. That’s the spirit!

“Listen, Sakura-chan and Motoyasu-kun, don’t make such a big fuss over something this small. We talked about this on the way here, so you should already know, right?　It was already decided that I’d be the one taking care of her.”
“I knew that, but… it just feels… weird…”
“Exactly!”
“Ugh… Fine, I’ll just put up with the registration order for now. Motoyasu, let’s talk later about whether to add me as a primary registrant for Sakura-chan.”
Huh? I’ll think about Father’s suggestion. The Demon Motoyasu whispered in my ear.
“Motoyasu, you’re now Filo-tan’s master. Is it really okay to do that to the masters?”
Wh—what do you mean by that? Just then, Angel Motoyasu appeared and whispered in my other ear.
“Motoyasu, you’re The Love Hunter. Is it really okay to lock Filo-chan away because of your possessiveness?”
“Don’t interfere, Angel! Feelings you won’t share with anyone are love too!”
“You’re the one who needs to repent! Love is the miracle of equality! Locking a love angel in a birdcage is an unforgivable sin!”
“Even a passion that burns like a raging fire is—love! You angel! You don’t understand love at all!”
Demon Motoyasu unleashes a Brionac at Angel Motoyasu.
“Guh!?”
“Just vanish right now!”
Angel Motoyasu has been defeated by Demon Motoyasu. It’s settled! I’ll have exclusive rights to this long-awaited situation—being Filo-chan’s master!
“Not… yet.”
What!? Angel Motoyasu gets back to his feet, battered and bruised, and replies.
“Is your love only for Filo-chan? Then what about Father? That would even call into question the very meaning of protecting her. The Filo-chan you love can only be complete with Father by her side!”
“Guaaaaaaaaaaa!?”
Angel Motoyasu is about to pierce Demon Motoyasu with the F=Evangel Spear.

“This is love… I’ll even acknowledge possessiveness as a form of love. But… you mustn’t neglect the very thing that truly shapes Filo-chan. That’s exactly why Sakura-chan won’t come out of her shell and is hiding Filo-chan’s true identity.”
What?! Ugh… Sakura-chan! So that’s why you won’t become Filo-tan. I, Motoyasu, deeply repent!
“F… Fine. But mark my words. A second and third Demon Motoyasu will appear, and the day will come when they defeat you! Hahahahaha!”
With those words, Demon Motoyasu vanished.
“No matter what happens, love will triumph in the end!”

Angel Motoyasu summed it up beautifully. It often seems like the demons come out on top, but this time the angel won. This, too, is the work of my love. While I was having this internal dialogue, Father ended up entering into a master-servant contract with Rival.
“Boo!”
Sakura-chan has been voicing her dissatisfaction the whole time.
“Sakura-chan, when we get home, I’ll register Father as your master, too.”
“Yay, okay!”
“Gau!”

Seizing the moment, Rival let out a triumphant roar at us, but I’ll hold my tongue for now. After all, it’s a fact that he still has quite a few disadvantages in his current state. And so, we hurried back to Melromarc.

Our Finacée welcomed us back to the castle. Then, to ensure the talks went smoothly, we had the Dragon Emperor’s Core Stones brought in. Since the ones from Siltvelt had been stolen, they were provided from Melromarc’s treasury.

It seems a few of them were duds, but we did find a few that worked. Rival is plucking those Dragon Emperor’s Core Stones and eating them. Oh, and of course, in the meantime, I shared the primary ownership of Sakura-chan with Father.
Then, while I was talking with Rival, Yuki-chan and the others protested, saying the conversation wouldn’t go anywhere, so they were entrusted to my Finacée and made to wait in a separate room.
“Gau-gau… test, test… yeah, I can talk now. Hmm… Gaelion really is inconvenient right after a loop, isn’t it?”
Rival seized the moment, mumbled a bit, and then started speaking. His usual fawning behavior really gets on my nerves.
“Um… so you’re the dragon who parasitized your memories onto Motoyasu-kun’s spear to piggyback on the loop, right?”
“That’s right! I’m Gaelion! Oh, but Wild Ofumi used to call me Meslion!”
Come to think of it, Father in the first world did call me that. Apparently, having the same name is a hassle.
“Why?”
“Because I’m a female Gaelion! In Wild Ofumi’s world, there are two Gaelions. The other one is a male.”
“Huh… So what should I call you, then?”
“Both names are important, so you can call her either one! You could even use a name unique to Naofumi in this loop!”
“Don’t think you can just try to curry favor with her right now—it won’t work!”
I point my spear at Rival to intimidate him.
“We’re still just at the self-introduction stage. I’m not doing anything as tacky as trying to curry favor.”
Rival is putting on a show of innocence, seizing the moment. I know what’s going on, though. There’s no doubt this guy has his sights set on Father. It’s better to be on guard.
“Now, now, Motoyasu, calm down. Or rather, you haven’t been calm at all since this whole thing started, so to put it bluntly… calm down.”
Father lowers his voice slightly to admonish me. Oh no! Has my behavior worn him out!? But I have a feeling I can’t back down now.
“Lord Kitamura, I understand you’re unhappy, but this is necessary, isn’t it? It’s something we can’t avoid. If there were a problem, Lord Iwatani wouldn’t be complaining either.”
“Honestly, I wish the Spear Hero would cut the nonsense… I get that you want to be cautious about all sorts of things, but surely the Shield Hero understands that much.”
“Yes. You’d like our cooperation moving forward, right?”

Éclair and the others are all speaking as if I’m the one in the wrong. Ugh… I guess I have no choice. I’ve got no choice but to wait for his true colors to show. Sakura-chan, please bear with me for a little while longer.
He’s bound to say something weird and gross out Father anyway. When that happens, I’ll laugh my head off! HAHAHA!
“For now, I’ll call you Gaelion-chan.”
“Got it. No matter what you call me, Gaelion will answer.”
I’m tempted to point something out, but since it’s Father’s order, I’ll keep quiet. Stay calm, stay cool, and stay composed. It’s like meditating to clear my mind of impure thoughts.
“So, Gaelion, do you know anything about our situation?　Is it okay if I ask you a few other things, too?”

“Even if you call it ‘our situation,’ Gaelion… ever since I went to Ofumi’s wild world, I haven’t been backing up my memories as much, so there’s a lot I don’t really know. It’s more like I forgot to turn off the auto-activation feature I’d set for the legendary spear.”
A backup, you say? I don’t really understand what this guy is talking about.
“...So, she’s not the ‘original’ Gaelion, and it feels like she hasn’t been updated much?”

“Hmm... that part’s a bit complicated to explain. In the world of ‘Wild Ofumi,’ Gaelion is dead and doesn’t exist, so you could say there’s no such thing as an ‘original,’ but since I’m talking like this, you could also say I do exist. Plus, I never expected the Spear Hero to loop again.”
“Well… I guess so.”

I don’t know anything about that either. Why is he looping…? Well, shouldn’t we just save the world like last time? There’s no point in worrying about things we don’t understand. The Eternal Filo-chan Project is 100 times more important than that, after all.
“The only thing Gaelion remembers is from around the time he’d been a Raph for a while.”
“Um, what’s a Raph?”
“Oh, he isn’t here in this loop? Actually, what’s the backstory? Naofumi, could you start from the beginning?”
“Huh? Okay, I’ll explain it step by step. First, I was summoned to this world as the Shield Hero, and on that very same day—”
And so, Father explained the series of events that took him from Melromarc to Siltvelt, and everything that happened after that.
